primary: Mean Cross minus Single paired binary root cause correctness among scorable non-Normal pairs
normal: False attribution among ANALYZED verified Normal outputs, coverage separate
matching: Match pre-adjudicated mechanism and causal attribution, service if required by variant, and evidence support; symptom alone insufficient
partial_correctness: Secondary ordinal only; partial counts as primary incorrect when scorable
abstention: Null for primary; separate rate; fault sensitivity counts as unsuccessful
provider_failure: Separate from abstention and counted unsuccessful in end-to-end sensitivity
pairing: Exact Order projection of same frozen Cross trace
grouping: Keep related configuration, campaign, templates and shared fixture groups together across splits
